title: Designer Info
body:
Everything you need to work here. Read all of it before you claim your first ticket.

Questions go to a higher rank, not to the customer.

options.label: Your First Week
options.title: Your First Week
options.content:
Read this whole panel. Only claim tickets in categories you can actually do.

Run `/qc` before anything reaches a customer. Log every finished order with `/log` or it doesn't count toward your payout.

Ask questions early. A question costs five minutes, a wrong assumption costs a rebuild.

options.label: Claiming Orders
options.title: Claiming Orders
options.content:
Hit **Claim** to take an order. From then on it's yours.

Greet the customer and confirm the brief within 12 hours. Give a deadline you can actually hit. Post progress so they're not guessing.

If you can't finish it, say so early and hand it back. Claiming and going quiet is an infraction.

options.label: Quality Standards
options.title: Quality Standards
options.content:
Check dimensions and resolution. Kill stray layers, watermarks, and placeholder text. Spell every name right. Reread the brief and confirm you did what it asked.

Unsure about anything? Run `/qc` and let a reviewer look before the customer does.

options.label: Getting Paid
options.title: Getting Paid
options.content:
Use `/pass` to work out the gamepass price. Roblox takes 30%, so the pass has to be listed higher than what you want to receive. The command does the maths.

Log every order with `/log`. Check your totals with `/stats`.

Unlogged orders don't get paid out. No exceptions, we can't pay what we can't see.

options.label: Time Off
options.title: Time Off
options.content:
Run `/loa request` with a duration like `5d` or `2w` and a reason. HR approves or denies it.

Hand off any claimed tickets before your leave starts. Approved leave exempts you from activity checks.

Back early? `/loa end`.
